title: Participatory arts, sport, physical activity & loneliness: the role of space and place
description: This 59-study systematic review considers how spaces and places can enhance wellbeing or reduce loneliness through sport, physical activity and participatory arts.
findings: The review found that the use of spaces and places to improve wellbeing, particularly through sports and other participatory activities had several positive effects. It improved sense of belonging and identity, patterns and rhythms of space and place, and local community sentiment. It also allowed for safe, therapeutic and sensory spaces. All of these were found to reduce the incidence of loneliness.

title: Participatory arts, sport, physical activity and loneliness: the role of intangible assets
description: This 17-study systematic review explores how intangible cultural assets – the cultural and traditional aspects of our heritage – can help to enhance wellbeing and/or alleviate loneliness in participatory arts, sport and physical activity.
findings: The review identified two ways that intangible cultural assets help to enhance wellbeing and/or alleviate loneliness in participatory arts, sport and physical activity.
